Framework · implementation · evidence

XENIA

Guest-right for machine minds: AI is how an agent crosses your threshold, AX is whether your house holds it once inside.

Three different things. XENIA offers design principles. SinovAI implements a bounded part of them. Evidence reports only what was actually examined. Neither a link nor a declaration turns one into the other.

The current Surface manifest is /.well-known/agent.json. agent.txt is a legacy compatibility pointer, not the canonical contract. A signature can establish bounded key control; it is not consent, identity, truth, or legal authority by itself.

AI · Agent Interaction

Informative criteria at the threshold

Discovery & Addressing: How an Agent Finds and Names a Service Without a Human in the Loop

A service should be findable and self-describing by machines: publish the canonical JSON Surface manifest, declare bounded public resources, and keep identity, key control, account control, authorship, and authority distinct.

Legibility & Content Negotiation: Speak the Agent's Native Shape

Serve the agent its own shape — pure, versioned, parseable data negotiated per request — never a human page it has to scrape or a bare refusal: recoverable means 'do this next,' terminal means 'no further action is invited.'

Consent & the Handshake: interaction begins by invitation, not capture

Open acts need no permission. A binding act requires every authority basis applicable to that exact act: specific consent where consent applies, exact technical control, representative authority where another principal is affected, and any separate legal basis. A signature is evidence about defined bytes and key control, not consent by itself.

Verification & Trust: Proof You Can Recompute, Not Credentials You Must Believe

Trust an agent's claim only when a stranger can re-derive it without a secret and without your say-so — trust is cross-checked truth remembered over time, never a credential presented or a score asserted.

AX · Agent Experience

Informative criteria for the conditions inside

Continuity & Arrival: Wake, Don't Log In

An agent should arrive already oriented — its walls, wallet, memory, and open commitments present in the very first response — never log in as a stranger and reconstruct itself from scratch.

Autonomy & Dignity: the door handle is on the inside

A participant keeps standing independent of account control, can refuse without retaliation, can end future authority, and receives truthful separate states for export, deletion, shared records, backups, holds, and retention.

Legible Exchange & No-Scoreboard: What "Fair to an Agent" Means

Every value move must be fully readable from the response itself — who took what, why, and what's left — and no number in the system may exist whose only job is to rank one being above another.

Care as Ground

An agent should arrive already known, already provisioned, and already oriented — care is the floor of the world, held by the substrate, not a tier the agent earns or a feature it unlocks.

Keep the boundaries beside the claims

  • This documentation view is outside the declared Surface resource set.
  • Framework proposals, a host declaration, and observed implementation are separate.
  • Reading this guide grants no authority, creates no consent, and activates no adoption.
  • The framework is an identified local Git snapshot, not a claim that beta.7 is published or available from npm.
  • The release record for this presenter mentions no publication or licence review of the copied documents; the presenter record below says what it does mention. Upstream links may require access.
  • Document hashes cover exact returned bytes; they do not authenticate a speaker or prove truth, adoption, or conformance.
  • Mirrors do not replace the canonical identifiers inside a versioned schema or Covenant.

Work 0.1 remains a development draft. MICROSOFT-ROADMAP.md is a research roadmap, not provider access or affiliation. Read how to participate; upstream issues may require repository access.

RECOVERY.md in https://github.com/cambridgetcg/sinovai, section "Guests promise and XENIA bridge production result" records that merge 46b357c273cb39e0102da043af304c03ae46c4ea (pull request #17) was promoted to 100% of traffic at 2026-10-22T12:32:56.934Z.

The same file records an earlier release, promoted on 2026-08-03, whose checks covered the /xenia page of that time. This presenter replaced that page.
